newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Death toll in Russian blast reaches 16.
newsitem.headline: Death toll in Russian blast reaches 16.

text.p: Sixteen bodies have been found in the rubble of a two-storey office building in Russia's Urals region after it was destroyed by an explosion, an Emergencies Ministry spokesman said on Tuesday.
"Rescue works continue and there may be more victims found," the Moscow-based spokeswoman told Reuters.
He said 15 people had been recovered alive from the debris of the offices of a small oil refinery near the town of Kueda, 250 km (155 miles) south of the Urals regional centre of Perm.
The explosion on Monday was believed to have been caused by a kitchen gas canister.
